items.title: 32.8 Mausami tabdeeli ka fasalon par asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the effect of climate change on crops (PDF 239-240).

blocks.text: Zaraat woh sanat hai jo badalte mausam se sab se zyada mutasir hoti hai. Mausami tabdeeli se darja hararat, barish aur shadeed mausam mein tabdeeliyan kheti par seedha asar dalti hain. Garmi pani ki kami (dehydration) paida karti, jis se photosynthesis aur saans lena kamzor ho jata hai. Zyada darja hararat paude ka metabolism tez kar sakta hai, lekin paude bohat garam hon to heat stress se un ki barhotri aur paidawar kam hoti hai. Sardi bhi kuch fasalon ko nuqsan deti aur chhote paudon ko maar sakti hai, jis se poori paidawar zaya ho jati hai.

items: Barish: aam barish paudon ko darkaar pani aur ghizai ajza deti hai, lekin barish ke badalte andaaz kuch ilaqon mein khushk-sali aur kuch mein selab la sakte hain, aur dono fasal tabah kar sakte hain; be-qaida barish aur badal phatna (cloudbursts) zarkhez oopri mitti baha le jate hain.

Shadeed waqiat: hurricanes, garmi ki lehrein aur ole fasalein aur kheti ka dhancha tabah kar sakte, jis se khurak ki qillat hoti hai. Toofan paude ukhaar aur shakhein tor dete, tez hawayein pani ki kami aur khushki laati, aur ole patton, phal aur tanon ko nuqsan dete; shadeed ole poori fasal tabah kar sakte hain.
Garmi aur UV: zyada UV index aur garmi ki lehrein fasalon par sakht heat stress dalti, pani ka zayaa tez karti aur patte jala sakti hain.

blocks.text: In tabdeeliyon se nimatne ke liye scientists aisi fasalon ki iqsaam bana rahe hain jo mukhtalif mausamon ko behtar bardasht karein, jaise khushk-sali bardasht karne wali makai aur garmi bardasht karne wali gandum. Khushk-sali aur selab bardasht karne wali khoobiyan bhi banayi gayi hain; maslan 'Sub1 rice' do hafte tak pani mein doobe reh kar bhi zinda reh sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Mausami tabdeeli fasal ki paidawar kam karne ke do tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: heat stress aur pani ki kami; badli barish se khushk-sali ya selab; badal phatne se oopri mitti ka katao; toofan, ole ya garmi ki lehron se tabahi; sardi se chhote paudon ki maut.

items: Garmi, sardi, khushk-sali, selab, toofan aur ole paidawar ghatate.
Nai iqsaam: khushk-sali bardasht makai, garmi bardasht gandum, Sub1 rice (do hafte pani mein zinda).
